verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents AI browser agents (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, BrowserUse) running in managed cloud sessions that you start "with a single API call," with no infrastructure to manage, so the submit-a-task part of the story is covered. The evidence never describes how results come back: there is no task-status polling endpoint and no webhook callback, only "watch them execute live," and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: documented polling/task-status retrieval, documented registrable webhooks, a published HTTP API reference for agent tasks, and independent hands-on corroboration.
